dorms_note: Lakeside Campus: runner-bot trip times (median of six, no Night Watch, seconds of game time at a fixed 60 Hz) per start hall and target combination; written by tests/test_routes_bots.gd for the default hall, read by tools/route_analysis.gd (a combination is curated only if its bot time also fits 95% of the round). Moonbrook College's are in route_bot_times_classic.json.
